connectors.authorityRequirement: Employer may import only resumes made available to that employer under Handshake candidate visibility/interaction rules; no platform crawling.
Career-services export must be made by an authorized institutional user; downstream reuse must remain within granted scope.
Institution/employer must have received the resume book through the institution's opt-in recruiting process or other explicit authorization.

globalRule: Imports consume already-authorized exports. Connector never automates login, candidate discovery, anti-bot bypass, or private-profile access.
